narrative:
## Handover Summary — Rolling Forecast & Scenarios

The rolling forecast is locked at GBP 3.79B, within 0.3% of plan, with a ±GBP 62M scenario range.

## Key Decisions
- Corporate PMI forecast re-baselined on the Q3 renewal book
- Bupa Global FX scenario set at 1.32 USD/GBP
- Scotland and Wales care fees updated to the confirmed 6.5% uplift

## Recommendations for Sign-off
- Present the downside scenario alongside the base case to the Board
- Move to a weekly forecast cadence after sign-off

## Risk Factors
- Medical inflation above 8%
- Further sterling strength

signals.title: Bupa Global FX Sensitivity
signals.excerpt: International premiums are largely USD-linked; a 1.32 USD/GBP rate reduces sterling revenue by about GBP 16M versus plan rates.

signals.title: Local Authority Care Fee Uplifts 2027
signals.excerpt: Fee uplifts confirmed at 6.5% in Scotland and Wales and around 5% in England, ahead of the 4% assumed in the draft plan.
